_what: Every colour and shape NoobCube uses, in one place.
_why: The app, the website and the taster on the bio site are meant to feel like one thing. They are written in three languages and none of them can read the others, so the numbers are kept here and written into each of them by Tools/sync_design.py. Change a colour here, run the tool, and everywhere agrees.
_source: Measured off the app icon (NoobCube/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/AppIcon-1024.png): the sticker colours are the lit faces of the cube in the artwork, the glow either side of it is the cyan and magenta, and the background is the colour at the very edge.

stageTint._what: The colour each step of the solve is shown in, in order.

cube._what: How a cube is posed when it is standing still, in radians.
